Thanks for the call earlier. To complete the vendor master setup on our side we need the following items from BlueArc: 

- Legal entity name as it should appear on invoices (including suffixes).
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached as an editable sheet) or equivalent.
- W-9 (or appropriate tax form) for US entities.
- Certificate of incorporation / articles (PDF).
- Remittance address and preferred PO contact (name, title, email, phone).
- Bank details only if you want ACH configured now (otherwise we can do check/Wire later).

Can you please send the W-9 and certificate and confirm the legal name + AP contact by end of day Wednesday (6/24)? If you prefer, you can upload docs to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3ExampleShared/bluearc-onboarding

Once we have those pieces Procurement will create the vendor record and map the PO routing. If you need a template for remittance or for privacy reasons prefer redacted bank details, let me know.

Thanks — I’ll loop Kimberly for tax confirmation and Jordan for PO owner mapping.

Best,
